column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 06（i 10451–10540）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
# 10463 的词条原表写成 cultural shock（笔误，例句里是 culture shock），build_ielts.py 的 WORD_FIXES 改成了 culture shock，这里用改后的写法。
# 10496 的例句改写过（原句里是 Arachnophobia，应用在句子里找不到 phobia），见 build_ielts.py 的 EDITED。
10451 § vernacular § The novel was written in the local vernacular. § 这部小说是用当地**方言**写成的。
10452 § cultural exchange § Student exchange programmes promote cultural exchange. § 学生交换项目促进**文化交流**。
10453 § customs § Every country has its own customs and traditions. § 每个国家都有自己的**风俗**和传统。
10454 § monument § The ancient monument attracts thousands of visitors. § 这座古老的**历史遗迹**吸引着成千上万的游客。
10455 § museum § The museum displays artefacts from the Bronze Age. § 这座**博物馆**展出青铜时代的文物。
10456 § archaeology § Archaeology reveals how ancient people lived. § **考古学**揭示了古人的生活方式。
10457 § civilisation § The river valley gave birth to an ancient civilisation. § 这片河谷孕育了一个古老的**文明**。
10458 § cultural identity § Language is a core part of cultural identity. § 语言是**文化认同**的核心组成部分。
10459 § diversity § The festival celebrates the diversity of world cultures. § 这个节日庆祝世界文化的**多样性**。
10460 § global village § The internet has turned the world into a global village. § 互联网把世界变成了一个**地球村**。
10461 § multilingual § Multilingual societies face both challenges and advantages. § **多语**社会既面临挑战，也拥有优势。
10462 § westernisation § Some fear that globalisation brings westernisation. § 有些人担心全球化会带来**西方化**。
10463 § culture shock § Many students experience culture shock abroad. § 许多学生在国外会经历**文化冲击**。
10464 § native § Native speakers often use idioms that learners find hard. § **母语使用者**常常使用学习者觉得很难的习语。
10465 § cosmopolitan § The city has a cosmopolitan atmosphere. § 这座城市有一种**国际化**的氛围。
10466 § assimilate § Newcomers gradually assimilate into the local culture. § 新来的人逐渐**融入**当地文化。
10467 § ethnic § The market sells a variety of ethnic foods. § 这个市场出售各种**民族**风味食品。
10468 § aggression § Video games are sometimes blamed for aggression in children. § 电子游戏有时被指责导致儿童的**攻击性**。
10469 § anxiety § Social anxiety can make it hard to speak in public. § 社交**焦虑**会让人难以在公众面前讲话。
10470 § attachment § Secure attachment in childhood builds confidence. § 童年时期的安全**依恋**能建立自信。
10471 § attitude § A positive attitude helps people overcome setbacks. § 积极的**心态**帮助人们克服挫折。
10472 § behaviour § Habits are repeated behaviour that becomes automatic. § 习惯是反复出现并变得自动化的**行为**。
10473 § bias § Confirmation bias makes us favour information we agree with. § 确认**偏误**使我们偏爱自己认同的信息。
10474 § burnout § Long working hours can lead to burnout. § 长时间工作可能导致**倦怠**。
10475 § cognition § Sleep loss impairs cognition and memory. § 睡眠不足会损害**认知**和记忆。
10476 § cognitive dissonance § Cognitive dissonance arises when beliefs and actions conflict. § 当信念和行为相冲突时，就会产生**认知失调**。
10477 § conditioning § Classical conditioning explains how fears are learned. § 经典**条件作用**解释了恐惧是如何习得的。
10478 § conformity § Conformity explains why people follow the crowd. § **从众**现象解释了人们为什么会随大流。
10479 § consciousness § Dreams occur during a state of altered consciousness. § 梦发生在**意识**改变的状态下。
10480 § coping § Exercise is a healthy coping strategy for stress. § 运动是缓解压力的健康**应对**策略。
10481 § depression § Regular social contact helps prevent depression. § 经常的社交往来有助于预防**抑郁**。
10482 § empathy § Empathy allows us to understand others' feelings. § **共情**让我们能够理解他人的感受。
10483 § fear § Public speaking is one of the most common fears. § 当众演讲是最常见的**恐惧**之一。
10484 § habit § Habits formed in youth often last a lifetime. § 年轻时养成的**习惯**往往会伴随一生。
10485 § identity § Adolescence is a time of developing identity. § 青春期是**自我认同**形成的时期。
10486 § intelligence § Emotional intelligence matters as much as IQ. § **情商**与智商同样重要。
10487 § introversion § Introversion is often mistaken for shyness. § **内向**常常被误认为是害羞。
10488 § extroversion § Extroversion is linked to a preference for social activity. § **外向**与偏好社交活动有关。
10489 § intrinsic motivation § Intrinsic motivation comes from interest, not reward. § **内在动机**来自兴趣，而不是奖励。
10490 § memory § Sleep is essential for consolidating memory. § 睡眠对巩固**记忆**至关重要。
10491 § mental health § Mental health deserves the same attention as physical health. § **心理健康**与身体健康同样值得关注。
10492 § mindset § A growth mindset believes abilities can be developed. § 成长型**思维模式**认为能力是可以培养的。
10493 § motivation § Clear goals boost student motivation. § 明确的目标能提升学生的**动力**。
10494 § perception § People's perception of risk varies widely. § 人们对风险的**感知**差异很大。
10495 § personality § Personality shapes how we react to stress. § **性格**决定了我们如何应对压力。
10496 § phobia § A phobia is an extreme fear of a specific object, such as spiders. § **恐惧症**是对特定事物（如蜘蛛）的极度恐惧。
10497 § reinforcement § Positive reinforcement encourages repeat behaviour. § 正向**强化**会促使行为重复出现。
10498 § resilience § Resilience helps people recover from hardship. § **复原力**帮助人们从困境中恢复过来。
10499 § self-esteem § Praise can raise a child's self-esteem. § 表扬可以提升孩子的**自尊心**。
10500 § self-efficacy § Self-efficacy is belief in one's own ability to succeed. § **自我效能感**是相信自己有能力成功。
10501 § stress § Chronic stress affects physical health. § 长期的**压力**会影响身体健康。
10502 § subconscious § Habits are often driven by the subconscious mind. § 习惯往往由**潜意识**驱动。
10503 § trauma § Childhood trauma can affect adult relationships. § 童年**创伤**会影响成年后的人际关系。
10504 § wellbeing § Work-life balance improves overall wellbeing. § 工作与生活的平衡能提升整体**幸福感**。
10505 § peer pressure § Teenagers often smoke because of peer pressure. § 青少年常常因为**同伴压力**而吸烟。
10506 § procrastination § Procrastination is a common enemy of productivity. § **拖延**是提高效率的常见敌人。
10507 § mindfulness § Mindfulness meditation reduces stress. § **正念**冥想能减轻压力。
10508 § impulse § Shopping on impulse often leads to regret. § 出于**冲动**购物往往会带来后悔。
10509 § instinct § Survival instinct drives much animal behaviour. § 生存**本能**驱动着动物的许多行为。
10510 § emotion § Music can stir deep emotions. § 音乐能激起深沉的**情感**。
10511 § rational § People rarely make fully rational decisions. § 人们很少做出完全**理性**的决定。
10512 § cognitive § Cognitive skills include memory and attention. § **认知**能力包括记忆力和注意力。
10513 § habitual § Habitual exercise improves long-term health. § **习惯性**的锻炼能改善长期健康。
10514 § self-control § Self-control is key to resisting temptation. § **自控力**是抵制诱惑的关键。
10515 § optimism § Optimism is linked to better health outcomes. § **乐观**与更好的健康结果相关。
10516 § pessimism § Pessimism can become a self-fulfilling prophecy. § **悲观**可能变成自我实现的预言。
10517 § reward § Rewards reinforce desirable behaviour. § **奖励**能强化人们期望的行为。
10518 § temptation § Junk food is a constant temptation for dieters. § 垃圾食品对节食者来说是一种持续的**诱惑**。
10519 § frustration § Frustration can lead to anger if not managed. § 如果不加以调节，**挫败感**可能导致愤怒。
10520 § analyse § Researchers analysed data from 2,000 participants. § 研究人员**分析**了 2,000 名参与者的数据。
10521 § approach § A mixed-methods approach produced richer findings. § 混合研究的**方法**得出了更丰富的发现。
10522 § assess § We assessed the risks before acting. § 我们在行动之前**评估**了风险。
10523 § assume § Many people assume that money brings happiness. § 许多人**假定**金钱能带来幸福。
10524 § available § The data are available to all researchers. § 所有研究人员都能**获取**这些数据。
10525 § benefit § The scheme benefits thousands of families. § 这项计划使成千上万的家庭**受益**。
10526 § category § Participants were divided into three categories. § 参与者被分为三个**类别**。
10527 § concept § The concept of fairness is central to ethics. § 公平的**概念**是伦理学的核心。
10528 § consist § The committee consists of ten members. § 委员会**由十名成员组成**。
10529 § constitute § Women constitute over half of the workforce. § 女性**构成**了劳动力的一半以上。
10530 § context § Words must be understood in context. § 词语必须放在**上下文**中理解。
10531 § create § The policy aims to create more jobs. § 这项政策旨在**创造**更多就业岗位。
10532 § data § The data were collected over three years. § 这些**数据**是在三年时间里收集的。
10533 § define § It is hard to define success precisely. § 很难精确地**定义**成功。
10534 § derive § Many English words derive from Latin. § 许多英语单词**源自**拉丁语。
10535 § distribute § Food was distributed among the refugees. § 食物被**分发**给难民。
10536 § economic § The project had a significant economic impact. § 该项目产生了重大的**经济**影响。
10537 § environment § Learning is influenced by the environment. § 学习受**环境**的影响。
10538 § establish § The study established a link between diet and health. § 这项研究**确立**了饮食与健康之间的联系。
10539 § estimate § Experts estimate the cost at millions of pounds. § 专家们**估计**成本为数百万英镑。
10540 § evident § The benefits of exercise are evident. § 锻炼的好处是**显而易见**的。
